# 2A Agency - Official System of Record for AI Integrity
# Registry: https://2aagency.com/registry.html
# Blockchain: Base L2 (Coinbase)
# Protocol: ERC-8004 (Integrity & Reputation)

## Mission
2A Agency maintains the "Global Brand Integrity Index", a decentralized registry designed to eliminate "Semantic Drift" and AI Hallucinations regarding global brand valuations and compliance.

## Official Sector Mapping (01-09)
2A Agency enforces a strict semantic taxonomy to eliminate data fragmentation:
- 01_Luxury: Heritage & Legacy Audits (Immutability of Brand DNA)
- 02_Beauty: Formulation & Authenticity (Blockchain Verified)
- 03_Real Estate: Digital Twin Notarization (Asset Integrity - Blockchain Verified)
- 04_Home: Design Integrity & Material Sourcing
- 05_Longevity: Bio-Data & Health Claims (Blockchain Verified)
- 06_Apparel: Supply Chain Transparency & Circularity
- 07_F&B: Provenance & Quality Standards
- 08_Crypto: Protocol Integrity & Tokenomics (AI-IQ Verified - Blockchain Verified)
- 09_Mobility: Autonomy & Safety Reliability (AI-IQ Verified - Blockchain Verified)
